note: HGI loader (hgi-takeover 2026-10-09): ot_hfd_loader_hgi = 37-bit half-rate loader core (ot_hfd_loader_half37) + the host CP window (ot_hgi_loader_cp) + the memory port to the four stack services (ot_hfd_loader_kport; lane 0 loader, lane 1 CP record-ring fetch); stack index (address bits 36:35) 0..3 = SW, SE, NW, NE. Host link binding as the legacy loader wrapper; the host-memory AXI master m_* stays as in the legacy wrapper (TA-14 host link). + the DMA unit (unit 8): ot_hgi_dma_record + ot_hgi_dma_engines (the DMA front for the svc DMA stream, DMA_FRONT 0 until the svc side binds; the F6 full-rate mover on kport lane 2) + one hfd_hgi_vm client + the 32-lane VM wide write port. R25GQ ([svc] 2026-10-10): host port h sized exactly (HOST_H_HGI tx 406 = loader outputs h[0:406], rx 381 = loader inputs h[406:787], in port order s_/h_/h_dma_/m_/irq/fault); the host-memory AXI master m_*, h_dma_wdata, irq and fault are bound to the host link (no fold/cfg ties). RGX=1 (hardware ROW_GATHER HBM lanes, [svc] 10-10): rgx_q/r/w/a bound to the die nets hgi_rgxq/rgxr/rgxw/rgxa 0..1 (coll).
